Rashi on Pesachim 90a:10:1.english: But the reason, etc. - This is an objection.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:12:1.hebrew: ואם ימעט הבית וגו' - אם יהיו מעות מועטין לבעל הפסח. מהיות משה — שאין לו במה לקנות לצורכי הפסח. ולקח הוא ושכנו הקרוב אל ביתו — יקח מעות משכנו וימננו על פסחו, ויקח מן המעות מה שהוא צריך לפסח:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:12:1.english: And if the household be too little, etc. - If the owner of the Paschal lamb has too little money. "For a lamb" — [meaning] that he does not have the means to buy [what is needed] for the needs of the Paschal offering. "Then shall he and his neighbor next to his house take [one]" — he may take money from his neighbor and register him for [a share in] his Paschal lamb, and take from the money whatever he needs for the Paschal offering.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:12:2.hebrew: מכדי אכילה - אם יחסר לו מעות, שאין לו במה ליקח צורכי אכילת הפסח, כגון עצים לצלותו, רשאי הוא למוכרו:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:12:2.english: Sufficient means to eat - If he lacks money, [such] that he has nothing with which to purchase the necessities for eating the Paschal lamb, such as wood to roast it, he is permitted to sell [a portion of] it.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:12:3.hebrew: ולא מכדי מקח - שאם אין לו מעות לסחורה, אינו רשאי למכור פסחו לכך:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:12:3.english: And not [when lacking] sufficient means to purchase - That if he does not have money for merchandise, he is not permitted to sell his Pesach [offering] for that [purpose].

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:14:1.hebrew: כו"ע לא פליגי - דיכול להימנות אחרים ליקח במעות עצים:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:14:1.english: No one disagrees - that one may register others [for the Paschal lamb] to purchase wood with the money.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:16:1.english: Sustain the lamb - Attend to the needs of the Paschal lamb from the money.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:17:1.hebrew: ולאביי דאמר - לעיל אליבא דרבי, בפסח לא משייר איניש — הא קתני "שעל מנת כו'", אלמא פסח גופיה ממון בעלים הוא:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:17:1.english: And according to Abaye, who said - earlier, according to Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi], [that] with a Paschal lamb a person does not leave [any of it unconsecrated] — behold, [the baraita] teaches, "[that] on [this] condition, etc.," thus [showing that] the Paschal lamb itself is the property of [its] owners.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:18:1.hebrew: אימא מעות פסחיהן - זה שנתמנה עמו לפסחו ונתן לו מעותיו, חולין היו, ונתן לו במתנה, ומשום הכי יכול ליקח בהן טלית, ונותן לו חלק של פסחו במתנה. ומעותיו חולין הן, שעל מנת כן הקדישן, שאם רצה ליתנם במתנה, יתנם:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:18:1.english: Say: money for their Paschal lambs - This [person] who registered with him for his Paschal lamb and gave him his money — [the money] was non-sacred, and he gave [it] to him as a gift; and therefore [the recipient] can buy a cloak with it, and he gives him a portion of his Paschal lamb as a gift. And his money is non-sacred, for it was on this condition that he consecrated it, that if he wants to give it as a gift, he may give it.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:19:1.english: A zav who saw two sightings - For his impurity is a seven-[day] impurity, and he does not require an offering.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:19:2.hebrew: שוחטין עליו בשביעי - ואע"פ שלא העריב שמשו, דהא חזי למיכל לאורתא:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:19:2.english: One slaughters on his behalf on the seventh [day] - And even though his sun has not [yet] set, since he is fit to eat [it] in the evening.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:19:3.english: He saw three [sightings] - Because he is not fit to eat [sacrificial meat] until he brings [his] atonement [offering].

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:19:4.hebrew: שוחטין עליו - אם חל שמיני שלו בערב הפסח, ואפילו לא הביא כפרתו, ומביאה לאחר מיכן, דמחוסר כפורים דחי עשה דהשלמה, כדאמרן בתמיד נשחט (דף נט.):
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:19:4.english: One slaughters on his behalf - If his eighth [day] falls on Passover eve, even if he has not [yet] brought his atonement [offering], and he brings it afterward, for one lacking atonement overrides the positive commandment of completion, as we said in [the chapter] Tamid Nishchat (59a).

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:1:1.hebrew: אמר אביי אי לאו דאוקמא ר' אושעיא - להא דתנן לקמן, דאתנן חל על המוקדשים, בממנה לזונה על פסחו באתננה. ואע"ג דאין אדם אוסר דבר שאינו שלו, הכא אמרינן דאתנן חל עליו:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:1:1.english: Abaye said: If not that Rabbi Oshaya established - that [mishna] that we learned later on, [stating] that [the prohibition of] a harlot's hire takes effect upon consecrated [animals], as [referring to] one who registers a harlot for his Paschal lamb as her hire. And even though a person cannot render prohibited something that is not his, here we say that [the prohibition of] a harlot's hire takes effect upon it.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:1:2.hebrew: ורבי היא - דאית ליה פסח ממון בעלים הוא, דאמר לקמן: אף מכדי מקח, שאם ימעטו לו מעות לבעל הפסח ליקח חלוק וטלית, ממנה אחרים עמו על פסחו ונוטל מהן מעות ועושה צרכיו — אלמא שלו הוא ויכול לאוסרו. אי לאו דאוקמא רבי אושעיא במסכת תמורה לההיא כדפרישית, אנא הייתי מוקי לה ההיא דאתנן בקדשים קלים, שנתן לה שלמים באתננה ויש בידו לאוסרן, ורבי יוסי הגלילי היא, דאמר בפרק קמא דב"ק (דף יב:): קדשים קלים ממון בעלים הם. והאי מתניתא דלעיל, דקתני מעות חולין, הוה מוקמינא כרבי; והוה אמינא דהא דשרי רבי לעשות צרכיו במעות, לאו משום דפסח אית ביה שיור בקדושתו ליתפס קדושת המעות בחולין שבו, אלא משום דזה שמפריש המעות שייר בקדושתו לתתם מתת חולין לבעל הפסח. והא ליכא לאוקמי כר' יוסי, דהא קתני: בשלמים לא עשה כלום. וההיא דאתנן כר' יוסי, ובפסח לא הייתי מוקי לה, דלא הוה סלקא דעתאי דפסח לרבי ממון בעלים הוא, שיהא בידו לאוסרו:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:1:2.english: And it is [according to] Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi] - Who holds that a Paschal lamb is the monetary property of its owner, for he says later [in the Mishnah]: Even as much as a purchase — that if the owner of the Paschal lamb lacks money to buy a shirt and a cloak, he may register others with him on his Paschal lamb, take money from them, and use it for his needs — thus [we see] it is his own and he is able to render it forbidden. Had Rabbi Oshaya not established that [Mishnah] in Tractate Temurah as I explained, I would have established that [Mishnah] concerning a harlot's hire as referring to offerings of lesser sanctity — that he gave her peace-offerings as her hire, and it is in his power to render them forbidden — and it is [in accordance with] Rabbi Yosei HaGelili, who says in the first chapter of Bava Kamma (12b) [that] offerings of lesser sanctity are the monetary property of their owners. And this baraita above, which teaches [that] the money is non-sacred, I would have established according to Rabbi; and I would have said that the reason Rabbi permits him to use the money for his needs is not because a Paschal lamb has a reservation in its sanctity such that the sanctity of the money takes hold upon the non-sacred aspect in it, but rather because the one who sets aside the money left a reservation in its sanctity to give it as a non-sacred gift to the owner of the Paschal lamb. And this [baraita] cannot be established according to Rabbi Yosei [HaGelili], for it teaches: With peace-offerings he has done nothing. And that [Mishnah] of a harlot's hire [I would have established] according to Rabbi [Yosei], and I would not have established it as referring to a Paschal lamb, because it would not have entered my mind that a Paschal lamb, according to Rabbi, is the monetary property of its owner such that it would be in his power to render it forbidden.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:20:1.hebrew: שומרת יום כנגד יום - הרואה יום אחד בתוך אחד עשר ימים שבין נדה לנדה, דבעיא לספור יום המחרת, שוחטין עליה ביום ספירה. דכיון שספרה מקצת היום, מותרת לטבול, ואף על פי שמחוסרת הערב שמש, שוחטין עליה:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:20:1.english: A woman who keeps watch a day for a day - [This refers to] one who sees [a discharge on] one day within the eleven days between [one] niddah [period] and [the next] niddah [period], who must count the following day; one slaughters [the Paschal lamb] on her behalf on the day of [her] counting. For once she has counted part of the day, she is permitted to immerse, and even though she still lacks sunset [to complete her purification], one slaughters [it] on her behalf.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:21:1.hebrew: והזבה - שראתה שלשה רצופים בתוך אחד עשר יום, וצריכה לספור שבעה נקיים ולהביא קרבן. שוחטין עליה בשמיני, ותביא כפרתה קודם שתחשך, ותאכל:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:21:1.english: And a zavah - [one] who saw [blood on] three consecutive [days] within eleven days, and needs to count seven clean [days] and bring an offering. One slaughters [the Paschal lamb] on her behalf on the eighth [day], and she brings her atonement [offering] before it grows dark, and she eats [of the Paschal lamb].

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:2:1.hebrew: דלא משייר איניש - בקדושת הגוף דבהמה. וטעמא דרבי, דאמר אף מכדי מקח, משום דבמעות משייר איניש לתתם מתת חולין בחזקת חולין, ומעיקרא אדעתא דהכי אפרשינהו, ומשום הכי חולין הם. דזה שהפריש לפסחו ואחר כך הימנה אחרים עמו, מתנה בעלמא הוא דיהיב להו, והנך יהבו ליה ממעות חולין מתנה. והממנה זונה, מתנה הוא, שאין בידו למוכרו, ואין אתנן חל עליו:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:2:1.english: That a person does not leave over [any rights] - in the physical sanctity of the animal. And the reason of Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi], who says "even to the extent of a purchase," is because with regard to money, a person does leave [it] over [as non-sacred] to give them as a gift of non-sacred [funds] in the status of non-sacred [funds], and initially he designated them with this intent; and because of this, they are non-sacred. For this one who designated [an animal] for his Paschal lamb and afterward registered others with him — it is merely a gift that he is giving them, and those [others] are giving him a gift from non-sacred money. And [as for] one who registers a prostitute — it is a gift, since it is not in his power to sell it, and [therefore] the [disqualification of a] harlot's hire does not take effect upon it.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:6:1.hebrew: והשתא דאוקמא ר' אושעיא לההוא בממנה זונה על פסחו - אלמא קא סבר ר' אושעיא פסח גופיה לר' ממון בעלים, ושמעינן מינה דאפי' בפסח משייר איניש, כל שכן מעות. וכ"ש דמצינן לאוקמא להך דקתני מעות שבידו חולין כרבי, דהא פסח חולין הוא ויכול למוכרו, ומעות של אותן אחרים חולין הוה, וליכא לאקשויי היאך הקדש חל על הקדש לצאת לחולין:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:6:1.english: And now that Rabbi Oshaya established that [case] as [referring to] one who registers a prostitute for his Paschal lamb - Thus, Rabbi Oshaya holds [that] the Paschal lamb itself, according to Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi], [is considered] the owner's property, and we learn from it that even with a Paschal lamb a person leaves over [an unconsecrated portion], [and] all the more so [with] money. And all the more so can we establish that [teaching] which states, "The money in his hand is non-sacred," in accordance with Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi], for the Paschal lamb is non-sacred and he can sell it, and the money of those others is non-sacred, and there is no [room] to ask how consecration takes effect upon [something already] consecrated so as to render it non-sacred.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:7:1.english: These are permitted - As [the Gemara] derives below.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:8:1.english: Birds - Turtledoves and young pigeons that are not consecrated.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:8:2.hebrew: שהמום פוסל בהם - אף משהוקדשו, אין אתנן חל עליהם, כדיליף לקמן:
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:8:2.english: For which a blemish disqualifies them - Even after they have been consecrated, [the status of] a prostitute's payment does not take effect upon them, as [the Gemara] derives below.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:8:3.hebrew: עופות - חולין, שמום אין פוסל בהן מלהקדישם, דלא נאמר תמות וזכרות בעופות. אינו דין כו':
Rashi on Pesachim 90a:8:3.english: Birds - [i.e.,] non-sacred [birds], for a blemish does not disqualify them from being consecrated, since unblemishedness and maleness are not stated regarding birds. "Is it not [logically] right," etc.

Rashi on Pesachim 90a:9:1.english: An a fortiori inference regarding consecrated [animals] from now - That [the status of a prostitute's] payment should take effect upon them.

Tosafot on Pesachim 90a:14:1.hebrew: כי פליגי במצה ומרור - להאי לישנא צריך לומר דהך דאתנן אתיא כרבי יוסי הגלילי, דאמר קדשים קלים ממון בעלים הוא, להכי איצטריך "לכל נדר"; אבל כרבי לא מתוקמא, כיון דסבר להאי לישנא דפסח לא משייר אלא במצה ומרור לחודיה. ומיהו ההיא דלעיל, דקתני "מעות שבידו חולין" — היינו חולין לענין מצה ומרור, דכרבי יוסי הגלילי לא מיתוקמא, דקתני "לא עשה ולא כלום":
Tosafot on Pesachim 90a:14:1.english: Where they disagree is regarding matza and bitter herbs - According to this version, one must say that that [teaching] regarding a harlot's hire follows Rabbi Yosei HaGelili, who says that offerings of lesser sanctity are the property of the owner — therefore [the phrase] "for any vow" is needed; but it cannot be established according to Rabbi [Yehuda HaNasi], since according to this version he holds that the Paschal lamb leaves [room for using the proceeds] only for matza and bitter herbs alone. However, that [baraita] above, which teaches: "the money in his hand is non-sacred" — that means non-sacred with respect to matza and bitter herbs, for it cannot be established according to Rabbi Yosei HaGelili, since it teaches: "he has done nothing at all."

Tosafot on Pesachim 90a:16:1.hebrew: החיה עצמך משה - תימה, כיון דמקרא נפיק, מה צריך לטעמא שעל מנת כן הקדישו ישראל פסחיהם? ויש לומר דקא משמע לן קרא דדעתו לכך:
Tosafot on Pesachim 90a:16:1.english: "Sustain yourself from the lamb" - [It is] puzzling: since it is derived from a verse, why is there a need for the rationale that Israel consecrated their Paschal lambs on this condition? And one can say that the verse teaches us that his intention is for this.
